name.km: ចៀនខ្ញីងាវ

description: Fried crisp and showered with crisp-fried shredded ginger and garlic.
descriptionKm: ចៀនខ្ញី — បាញ់ខ្ញី និងខ្ទឹមហើយក្រៀម។
equipmentKm: ខ្ទះ ឬ ម៉ាសុីនចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាតសំបក

ingredients.itemKm: ប្រេងសម្រាប់ចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំងាវ៖ សម្អាតសំបក។

instructions.text: Pat dry and dust with seasoned flour.
Heat oil to 170°C. Fry the clams until the shells open and crisp.
instructions.tip: Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot and the crust stays crisp.

instructions.text: Crisp the ginger and garlic in the oil and scatter over the top with spring onion.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
